title: Bir Soru Düştü Yola
author: Mine Pöge
description:
When Rüya slips on her magical shoes, she embarks on a dreamlike journey through a whispering forest, a shimmering sea, a golden desert, and even the age of dinosaurs, asking everyone she meets the same question: Where does magic live? Each answer leads her to discover magic in a different form, from a tiny hope growing into a mighty tree to the traces we leave behind. 
Blending poetic, rhyming language with playful sound effects, A Question Set Out on a Journey celebrates children’s boundless curiosity and shows how a single question can open the way to wonder, imagination, and self-discovery.
english_title: A Question Set Out on a Journey
